Description:
  grimoire-cli — Grimoire TTRPG and wargame library CLI

Usage:
  grimoire-cli [command] [options]

Options:
  --debug         Enable debug-level logging (HTTP requests, token expiry, version check) to stderr.
  --log-json      Emit stderr log lines as single-line JSON instead of text.
  --pretty        Indent API response bodies. Off by default — responses are the server's bytes, unmodified. config get and --output receipts are always indented, regardless of this flag.
  --help-full     Show full help including the request and response shapes.
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  login            Authenticate with a Grimoire server
  me               Show the authenticated account
  config           Manage grimoire-cli configuration
  systems          Game systems (the folders under books/ and armory/)
  books            Read and edit book metadata
  library          Scan and index the library
  downloads        Bulk downloads
  addons           Install and manage metadata add-ons
  backups          Server backups of the database and user assets
  sidecars         Configure and backfill metadata sidecar files beside each book
  files            The library tree on disk
  maps             Read and edit map metadata
  models           Read and edit 3D model metadata
  tokens           Read and edit token metadata
  audio            Read and edit audio metadata
  search           Search page text and metadata across the library
  logs             Read the server's application log
  tags             Tags across every resource type
  duplicates       Find and resolve duplicate library items
  campaigns        Campaigns and the library items linked into them
  armies           Wargame army lists
  leagues          Wargame leagues
  pins             Your pinned folders and game systems
  genres           The genre vocabulary
  licenses         The license vocabulary
  parent-systems   The parent-system vocabulary
  system-families  The system-family vocabulary
  dice-materials   The dice/material vocabulary
  self-test        Verify the binary works (offline; no server needed)

Environment variables:
  GRIMOIRE_SERVER   Server URL, overriding the config file.
  GRIMOIRE_DEBUG=1  Same as --debug. Enables debug-level logging to stderr.
